title: Refuse every booting MCP launch, or only under the sim-test lock?
context:
Goal: Every simulator boot goes through the sim-test lock.
Problem (goal): The simulator MCP launch cannot run inside sim-test, so it can only be refused. A full refusal changes what sessions can do, so it needs your word.
Based on (read): bin/sim-test shuts down each simulator it booted, and simulator-boot-bypass refuses a raw simctl boot (PR #1145, head 425c2a073).
Departs from: main lets an MCP launch boot under the cap and reuse rules — PR #1145 refuses it while a live pid holds the sim-test lock.

options.label: Refuse only under the lock
options.gain: Sessions can still view an app on a fresh simulator.
options.lose: An MCP launch that boots just before a sim-test run skips the lock.

options.label: Refuse every booting launch
options.how: Widen simulator-boot-locked to every MCP launch of a shut-down device.
options.lose: Viewing an app on a simulator needs you to boot one first, and the cap and reuse rules no longer judge MCP launches.
